text:
samir: FYI customer pinged with spikes and 500s, says traffic should be pinned to eu-dedicated but we see requests landing in hosted us-west and failing auth. could be a pin TTL / heartbeat mismatch.
ops-bot: Alert: tenant t-8423 routing deviation detected — 12% requests routed off-dedicated to hosted in last 10m :rotating_light: 
alyssa: Can you paste the earliest failing request id? we need a trace to see where routing happened.
samir: request_id=rx-20260317-9a1b; trace shows initial assign to eu-dedicated pool, then a routing fallback to hosted-us-west at decision-service step:route_v2. Logs: 
```
[2026-03-17T14:02:11Z] decision-service route_v2 tenant=t-8423 -> pool=eu-dedicated (pin_state=active,last_heartbeat=2026-03-17T13:57:09Z)
[2026-03-17T14:02:11Z] decision-service fallback -> pool=hosted-us-west (reason=capacity_breach, pin_ttl_expired)
[2026-03-17T14:02:11Z] proxy auth fail tenant=t-8423 token_mismatch target=hosted-us-west 401
```
maria: interesting — last_heartbeat is 5m old. heartbeat daemon should refresh every 60s. could be the heartbeat process for eu-dedicated nodes got delayed during the maintenance window. any infra events?
kevin: we did a rollout of a traffic-weight change 2h ago that touched the failover heuristics (PR #7483). not aware of heartbeat changes though. I'll check deploy timeline.
ops-bot: Note: related incident IM-3311 was triggered at 13:55 UTC for ephemeral node GC in eu-zone-3. That impacted agent heartbeats for ~7m.
alyssa: OK that lines up. Customer saw latency climb then auth 401s when requests spilled to hosted which expects a different service token. Need repro and mitigation. Samir can you share repro curl?
samir: Repro steps (customer QA):
1) set tenant pin to eu-dedicated: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://control.redwood/api/v1/pins -d '{"tenant":"t-8423","pool":"eu-dedicated"}'`
2) simulate node GC by pausing heartbeat on one dedicated node (or just kill agent)
3) send 100 concurrent requests to `/v1/generate` with tenant header `x-tenant: t-8423`
Expected: requests stay in dedicated; Observed: ~10-15% route to hosted and return 401 due to token mismatch
Example failing header from proxy: `X-Target-Pool: hosted-us-west`
kevin: Short-term mitigation: manually unpin then repin tenant after heartbeat stabilizes, or temporarily widen allowed hosted token mapping so hosted accepts dedicated tokens (riskier). I'll open an emergency rollback for PR #7483 if we see correlation.
billing-bot: FYI spike detected: hosted billing units for t-8423 increased +22% during spill window. Customer invoice could be impacted.
maria: Longer term: add conservative grace TTL on pin expiry when recent heartbeats exist, and add explicit token-mapping fallback so auth doesn't 401 if routed unexpectedly. Also add telemetry that ties request->decision event id to billing record.
alyssa: Action items: 
- kevin: confirm if PR #7483 touched failover TTL logic (ETA 30m)
- samir: gather full trace bundle for rx-20260317-9a1b and attach to the ticket (ETA 15m)
- ops: consider temporary tenant unpin/unrepin and notify customer about possible invoice adjustments (ETA asap)
I'll coordinate with SOC for a customer comms draft. :pray:
ops-bot: Ticket SC-5812 created and linked to incident IM-3311.
